description: This file defines the UpdateUI class, which provides utility methods for determining weather icon IDs based on weather conditions and times, as well as translating day names into localized strings within an Android weather app.

classes.name: UpdateUI
classes.description: Utility class for updating UI elements related to weather conditions and day translations.

methods.name: getIconID
methods.description: Determines the weather icon ID string based on weather condition code and time information.

methods.name: TranslateDay
methods.description: Translates English day names into localized strings using Android resources.
